idea.title: Show HN: Mljar Studio – local AI data analyst that saves analysis as notebooks

plan.tagline: Turn CSV files into Python notebooks with local AI insights
plan.problem: Freelancers and small agencies waste hours manually analyzing CSV data in spreadsheets or Jupyter notebooks
plan.solution: CLI tool that reads CSV, generates Python notebooks with automated insights, and saves results locally
plan.target_market: Freelance data analysts, small marketing agencies, and SaaS founders in SE Asia needing quick, offline data analysis
plan.demo_script: Run `pyanalyst --demo` to generate a sample notebook analyzing hardcoded sales data with trends and visualizations
plan.phuket_angle: Tourism businesses (hotels, tour operators) can analyze booking data offline without cloud costs
